name: Spiritus Sanctus
source:
You are a Church Inquisitor – judge, executioner, and purifier – sent to a decaying apartment where a young woman was brutally murdered, her body defiled in mocking yellow, with demons possibly hiding behind human faces, whispering lies.

Armed only with your faith, wits, and a cross that calls down holy fire, you must interrogate every resident, knowing that every answer could be a trap.

[From [url=https://nevermindnaum.itch.io/spiritus-sanctus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名教会审判官——法官、刽子手和净化者——被送到一间破旧的公寓，在那里一名年轻女子被残酷谋杀，她的身体被嘲弄的黄色玷污，恶魔可能隐藏在人类面孔后面，低声说着谎言。

仅凭你的信仰、智慧和召唤圣火的十字架，你必须审问每一位居民，知道每一个答案都可能是一个陷阱。

[来自[url=https://nevermindnaum.itch.io/spiritus-sanctus]Itch.io[/url]]
